name: AIBS Student Membership
summary: Free AIBS membership for students in accredited building surveying courses; students in other courses pay a reduced fee.
key: Free for students in AIBS-accredited courses; students in non-accredited courses pay $77 per year.
who: Enrolled in your first building surveying qualification at a recognised university, TAFE or training provider
how: Check eligibility, confirm whether your course is AIBS-accredited, then apply online with proof of enrolment.

evidence.quote: Students in non-accredited courses pay just $77 per year.
you must be enrolled in your first building surveying course.
